policies.name: Extended Producer Responsibility Act of 2022
policies.summary: Requires large companies to recover and recycle a rising portion of the plastic packaging they place on the market.

newsFeed.headline: Sachet economy still drives Philippine plastic waste, audit shows
newsFeed.summary: Brand audits found tiny single-use sachets dominate beach plastic in the Philippines, where many products are sold in 1-use portions.

wooby.headline: Tiny single-use sachets are a huge problem for Philippine seas.
wooby.narrative: Wooby has friends in the Philippines who say the worst plastic isn't bottles — it's tiny shampoo and coffee sachets that float everywhere. The country is pushing big companies to take their sachets back. Wooby thinks that is fair.

sources.publisher: Break Free From Plastic Brand Audit
